verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own pages say you can ask Copilot to "open a new pull request" in natural language and assign issues to Copilot to get a ready-to-review PR, which you can then iterate on and merge in the app. That means PRs can be created from the device, but only through Copilot. There is no evidence of creating a PR manually by choosing branches, and it covers GitHub only rather than hosted Git platforms generally. Missing for 10: documented manual PR creation (branch/base selection, title/description), support for Git hosts other than GitHub, and independent or hands-on confirmation of creating PRs from mobile.
